scope: Transparent filesystem compression in this task-managed checkout only. Every adopted copy has identical SHA256, size and permissions; original inode/mtime/size/content are rechecked immediately before atomic replacement. No file contents, paths, repository objects or user files removed. No unrelated worktrees touched.
limitations: Reduced per-file allocated blocks did not produce a matching net increase in available volume space. Filesystem sharing or concurrent allocation was not established. This is not enough free-space evidence to restart the build safely.
